QuestInfo.1: This place got suddenly busy! \r\nEverybody's rushing off somewhere... What is going on?
QuestInfo.2:
It seems you're the last to find out about the newly-discovered planet #bEluna Prime#k.
Rumor is, the world is full of extremely rare 'Elunite Crystals'.


The #bExpress to Eluna departs at #eevery hour on the hour, between between 9am and 12am#n.
Note that you can either #eboard via the invitation sent out before each departure#n, or #ewait at #m867118000# and board when it's time to depart#n.
